name: SQL Server Change Tracking
description: Read changed rows from a SQL Server table with Change Tracking enabled, using CHANGETABLE(CHANGES ...) -- the real native SQL Server CDC-lite mechanism, not a generic polling diff.
author: Dagster Community

outputs.description: pandas DataFrame of changed rows, with a sys_change_operation column (I/U/D)

connection_url_env_var.description: Env var holding a SQLAlchemy connection URL, e.g. 'mssql+pyodbc://user:pass@dsn'.
connection_url_env_var.label: Connection URL Env Var

schema_name.description: SQL Server schema the table lives in, e.g. 'dbo'.
schema_name.label: Schema Name

primary_key_columns.description: The table's primary key column(s), in order. Required -- CHANGETABLE only carries these plus change metadata; other columns are joined back from the base table.
primary_key_columns.label: Primary Key Columns

columns.description: Every column to read, including primary_key_columns. Required -- CHANGETABLE can't be queried with SELECT *.
columns.label: Columns

owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.
kinds.label: Kinds

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before this asset is considered stale.
freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)

freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 9am).
freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries
